Reference Text: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became fascinated by mortal settlements.
They loved the nicely paved ground in the city.
They admired the intricate bridges over quiet water.
They loved the houses most of all.
Stone walls formed shelters from the weather.
Those walls connected the earth with family stories.
They decided to learn housebuilding.
They used a touch of arcane magic.
Their self made staff hummed with green light.
The staff helped roots reach into the stone.
Pebble Spring shaped a small door from living wood.
The door opened onto a warm stone room.
Vines curled along the window frames.
The windows let in soft morning light.
The floor felt smooth under their feet.
The roof was thick with moss and leaves.
The chimney breathed soft smoke into the air.
The hearth made the room glow at night.
The walls remembered the songs of every family.
The city noticed the strange green house.
The neighbors brought pebbles and clay.
Pebble Spring thanked them with small flowers.
The home grew stronger each day.
The pebble home in the city had stone walls and vines and roots and windows and a door and a lamp and a hearth and a soft warm look and was very old and spotty
